members.name: HV_EXIT_REASON_CANCELED
members.doc: asynchronous exit requested explicitly by hv_vcpus_exit() call

members.name: HV_EXIT_REASON_EXCEPTION
members.doc: synchronous exception to a higher EL triggered by the guest

members.name: HV_EXIT_REASON_VTIMER_ACTIVATED
members.doc: ARM Generic VTimer became pending since the last hv_vcpu_run() call returned. The caller is expected to make the interrupt corresponding to the VTimer pending in the guest's interrupt controller. This exit automatically sets the VTimer mask. The VCPU will not exit with this status again until after the mask is cleared with hv_vcpu_set_vtimer_mask(), which should be called during a trap of the EOI for the guest's VTimer interrupt handler.

members.name: HV_EXIT_REASON_UNKNOWN
members.doc: Unable to determine exit reason: this should not happen under normal operation.

members.name: HV_SYS_REG_ACTLR_EL1
members.doc: @abstract The ACTLR_EL1 register @discussion This only allows getting / setting of the ACTLR_EL1.EnTSO bit (index 1). Setting this bit to 1 will cause the vcpu to use a TSO memory model, whereas clearing it will cause the vcpu to use the default ARM64 memory model (weakly ordered loads / stores).

hv_vcpu_exit_exception_t.doc: @abstract Contains details of a vcpu exception.

hv_vcpu_exit_t.doc: @abstract Contains information about an exit from the vcpu to the host.
